reports.notes: Handwritten in ALL CAPS over the printed v. 12.23 form. Office field reads 'UTAH COUNTY COMMISSION C' - the seat letter C is written tight against the right edge of the box (medium confidence on the trailing C); index.csv 'County Commission Seat C' agrees. Not redacted - the address, phone and email are legible on the page; only the city is recorded here per package privacy rules. Boxes A, B and D are the filer's SLASHED-ZERO glyph, transcribed as 0 (genuine written zeros, not blanks). FILER INCONSISTENCY, transcribed verbatim and NOT corrected: the form's own formula makes Box F = A + B = 0, but the filer wrote F = 13,894.23 and a Balance at Close of 10,044.28 - i.e. F and the close carry over the prior (7-days-before-General) period's figures rather than this period's. No arithmetic was performed here. In Box C the decimal separator is written as a comma-like glyph ('$13,894,23'); read as 13,894.23 at medium confidence by analogy with the clearly period-separated E and close. The cover page's 'Date of Report' box is left BLANK by the filer; report_date is taken from the signature date 12/6/24, which matches the summary page's own Date of Report box. Page 3 is a PHOTOCOPY of the previous filing's typed Schedule A (same 8 contributions, same 13,894.23 total) with the printed date '10/28/2024' struck through and '12/6/24 SB' handwritten beneath - re-used paperwork, not new itemization; not transcribed per this tranche's totals-only scope.

contributions.anchor: Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' ($13,894.23) on the p7 Summary Page, which equals the Schedule A grand-total footer printed on p3 (13,894.23) and the sum of the two Schedule A sheets' own printed page subtotals (5350 + 8,544.23). The promoted PER-PERIOD cell Box B prints a SLASHED ZERO and cannot be the anchor
contributions.detail: THE DOCUMENTED EXCEPTION (§A6), and it must be read loudly. This is the filer's 30-DAYS-AFTER-THE-GENERAL report, and it declares ZERO activity in its own period: Box B is an oval/slashed zero, which under the zero-glyph ruling is the numeral 0. But the filer did not file blank schedules — he re-bound the SAME Schedule A sheets from his 7-days-pre-General report and hand-re-dated them '12/6/24 SB', so the schedules restate the WHOLE CYCLE. Their rows therefore sum to the cumulative figure, not the period one: p2's 15 rows sum to 5,350.00 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 5350'; p3's 8 rows sum to 8,544.23 = its printed 'Subtotal for this page $ 8,544.23'; 5,350.00 + 8,544.23 = 13,894.23 = the grand-total footer on p3 = Box C. Each sheet was gated on its own printed subtotal first (§L2). Nothing was differenced across covers and no figure was synthesised: the sum is tested against the printed figure matching ITS OWN SCOPE, which here is the cumulative one. ⚠ THESE ROWS ARE THE SAME TRANSACTIONS AS 00c19030's AND MUST NEVER BE ADDED TO THEM — doing so would double-count every donor in this filer's cycle. Downstream consequence (§A6): the rows and their sum publish, and reconciles_contrib is left BLANK = UNKNOWN rather than True.

expenditures.detail: Same shape as the contribution side and for the same reason. Box D is an oval/slashed zero = 0 (zero-glyph ruling), while the three re-bound Schedule B sheets restate the whole cycle. Gated per sheet first (§L2): p4's 15 rows sum to 2,458.67 = its printed subtotal; p5's 15 rows sum to 810.64 = its printed subtotal; p6's 9 rows sum to 580.64 = its printed subtotal; 2,458.67 + 810.64 + 580.64 = 3,849.95 = the handwritten grand-total footer on all three sheets = Box E. ⚠ SAME TRANSACTIONS AS 00c19030's — never summed across the two documents. reconciles_expend is left BLANK = UNKNOWN.
